## deploy/release-notes-6.33.4-cb27.md
1 # Release notes: returns-svc build 6.33.4-cb27
2 
3 Previous build: 6.32.5. Defaults below override repository config files.
4 
5 - clients: default `clients.tax-engine.timeout_ms` lowered from 2500 to 750 (fail fast)
6 - cache: default `cache.ttl_s` unchanged (120)
7 - build: container base image refreshed
8 - metrics: db pool gauges renamed to `db_pool_*`
9 - tracing: sampling rate default 1% (unchanged)
10 - retry: idempotent GETs retried once on connect errors
11 - config: `log.level` default remains info
12 - deps: http client library upgraded to a patch release
13 - metrics: new histogram for cache hit latency
14 - logging: structured request ids added to access logs
15 - api: `/v1/status` returns build id
16 - locale: currency formatting fixes
17 - deps: json serializer upgraded
18 - docs: runbook links updated
19 - db: default connection pool `db.pool.max_size` lowered from 48 to 10 to fit the shared-db connection quota
20 - security: TLS session tickets rotated hourly
21 - feature flags: `ff-legacy-export` removed (was 0%)
## ops/oncall-notes.md
1 # On-call notes - returns-svc incident 2031-04-19
2 
3 Informal running notes. Not reviewed; may be out of date.
4 
5 - 08:31 edge-gw 5xx for returns-svc since build 6.33.4-cb27 rolled out. Many tax-engine timeouts.
6 - 08:41 Suspect the tax-engine timeout default change in 6.33.4-cb27; asking for a mitigation.
